tasks.title: Validate shared host lifecycle contract
tasks.description: Validate reusable CH01 host lifecycle contract for both platform and n8n tracks.

current default validation still passes

tasks.title: Implement shared start/rebuild task contract
tasks.description: Make CH01 reusable by platform and n8n tracks without duplicating host lifecycle logic.
acceptanceCriteria: both tracks consume shared CH01 capability

tasks.title: Validate shared host baseline contract
tasks.description: Validate CH02 baseline behavior for Kubernetes platform hosts and standalone n8n hosts.
acceptanceCriteria: baseline works for Kubernetes platform hosts

tasks.title: Implement baseline profile separation
tasks.description: Separate platform-k3s and standalone-n8n baseline profiles while preserving shared hardening primitives.
acceptanceCriteria: platform and n8n baseline profiles are separate
shared hardening primitives remain reusable

tasks.title: Define k3s single-node install and validation contract
tasks.description: Define and implement single-node k3s install, kubeconfig, data-dir, service exposure, and reboot survival validation for the platform track.
acceptanceCriteria: k3s install script exists and is idempotent
kubeconfig is accessible post-install
data-dir follows /srv contract

reboot survival is validated
validation script exists and passes
